A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a technique for evaluating,k-expressions that is lazy, but is also able to evaluate higher-order functions, and is able to do so without the need for a separate mechanism to represent the graph of a function.

we can implement abstract interpreters for higher-order languages in a very straightforward way.
